basic_information.recipe_name: HTHP Exhaust Dyeing of 100% Polyester Woven Fabric with Disperse Dyes

dye_information.dye_type: High-Thermal Fastness Disperse Dye (SE / HW Type)
dye_information.dye_name: Disperse Blue 79 (2.8% owf) + Disperse Navy 56 (1.0% owf) + Disperse Rubine 56 (0.2% owf)

chemical_information.chemical_function: Keeps non-ionic disperse dye particles suspended in water at 130°C
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Added to dye bath at 50°C before dye dispersion addition
chemical_information.compatibility: Compatible with non-ionic and anionic leveling agents

chemical_information.chemical_function: Maintains acidic bath pH to prevent disperse dye reduction
chemical_information.dosage: 1.0 g/L Acetic Acid + 0.5 g/L Sodium Acetate
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Dosed during bath setup to establish target pH 4.5 - 5.0
chemical_information.compatibility: Compatible with all disperse dye auxiliaries

process_parameters.temperature_profile: Start 60°C -> Heat to 90°C @ 2.0°C/min -> Heat to 130°C @ 1.0°C/min -> Hold 130°C for 45 min -> Cool to 80°C @ 1.5°C/min
process_parameters.heating_rate: 1.0 °C/min through critical plasticization strike zone (90°C to 130°C)

process_steps.pretreatment: Preshrunk and heat-set woven polyester; free of silicone knitting oils
process_steps.dye_addition: Disperse dyes pasted with warm water (50°C), high-shear mixed, filtered into tank
process_steps.salt_addition: N/A (Electrolytes not used in disperse dyeing)
process_steps.alkali_addition: N/A during dyeing bath; Caustic Soda added during Reduction Clearing
process_steps.washing: Drain 130°C bath at 80°C -> Hot rinse at 70°C
process_steps.soaping: Reduction Clearing: 2.5 g/L Hydros + 2.0 g/L NaOH + 1 g/L detergent at 80°C for 20 min
process_steps.neutralization: Drain RC bath -> Rinse -> Neutralize with 1.0 g/L Acetic Acid at 50°C for 10 min
process_steps.drying: Stenter frame drying and final heat-setting at 170°C for 30 seconds

machine_requirement.recommended_machine: Thies iMaster HTHP Jet Dyeing Vessel

quality_parameters.rub_fastness: Dry Rubbing: Grade 4-5 | Wet Rubbing: Grade 4
quality_parameters.uniformity: Completely streak-free and oligomer-free fabric surface

defects.common_defects: Oligomer White Powder Spotting, Color Specks, Thermal Translocation Unlevelness
defects.causes: Rapid cooling below 100°C, dye agglomeration, unstable pH > 5.5 during dyeing
defects.corrective_actions: Hot drain at 80°C; add high-temp dispersing agent; maintain pH strictly at 4.5

safety.ppe_required: Heat-resistant safety gloves, full face shield, protective chemical suit during sampling
safety.hazardous_chemicals: Sodium Hydrosulfite (spontaneously combustible when damp), Caustic Soda (corrosive)
safety.safety_precautions: Ensure vessel pressure gauge reads 0.0 bar before unlocking pneumatic door safety pin

references.source: Industrial Polyester HTHP Wet Processing Standards
references.notes: Monitor differential pressure across filter mesh to prevent dye aggregation
